cards.text: The LORD speaks to Ezekiel, His prophet, and calls him son of man. God has been picturing Samaria and Jerusalem as two sisters, Oholah and Oholibah, who became His but were unfaithful to Him (Ezekiel 23:4-5, 11). Now He asks Ezekiel if he will pass judgment against them.

cards.question: God tells Ezekiel to declare to Oholah and Oholibah their abominations.

cards.text: So God lays out the charges, and friend, this part is heavy. First, they have committed adultery, and blood is on their hands.

cards.question: God says the two sisters committed adultery with their ___.
What did the sisters do with the children they bore to God?

cards.text: And God isn't done. He says they did this to Him too: on that very same day, they profaned His Sabbaths.

cards.question: On the very day the sisters slaughtered their children for their idols, they stayed far away from God's house.

cards.text: The sisters went right into His sanctuary to profane it, inside His house. Then God speaks right to the sisters: they sent messengers for men who came from far away.

cards.question: When the men from far away arrive, what do the sisters do for them?

answers.text: They bathe and paint their eyes

cards.text: Then the sisters sit on a couch of luxury, with a table spread out in front of it. And what's sitting on that table is NOT theirs to set out.

cards.question: What's the problem with what the sisters set on their luxury table?

answers.text: It's God's own incense and oil
It's food meant for the poor
It's a gift from their enemies

cards.text: You can hear the sound of a carefree crowd. Drunkards from the desert and men from the rabble put bracelets on their wrists and beautiful crowns on their heads.

cards.question: God goes on to speak of "her who had grown old in adulteries" in this picture. What does that phrase tell you about her?

answers.text: She's been unfaithful a long time
She's too old to be judged now

cards.text: Then God says of her, "Now let them use her as a prostitute, for that is all she is!"
And the men slept with Oholah and Oholibah as with a prostitute. But God says the sisters will be sentenced to the punishment for adultery and bloodshed.

cards.question: God says ___ men will sentence the sisters.

cards.text: Then the Lord GOD speaks: bring a mob against the sisters and hand them over to terror and plunder. The mob will stone them, cut them down with swords and kill their sons and daughters.

cards.question: Along with everything else, the mob will ___ the sisters' houses.
God says He will put an end to indecency in the land.
God says all the women will be admonished not to imitate the sisters, and the sisters will bear the consequences of their sins of idolatry. Then what will the sisters know?

answers.text: That He is the Lord GOD
